svg.title: From a trefoil tube to a three-ended surface
svg.desc: Original topology schematic based on Mramor and Wang, Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 3.2. A trefoil tube is punctured three times and continued into three open annular ends. Not a computed self-expander.

g.text: From a trefoil tube to a three-ended surface
Mramor–Wang · genus 1, three ends · topology schematic
Boundary of a knotted solid torus
The proof protects the overpass bridges with expanding annular barriers (Figure 2).
This plate illustrates the topology in Theorem 1.1; it does not reproduce the Plateau construction.
The shown flares are chosen for the drawing. No self-expander equation has been solved.
